properties.name: Belváros
properties.sourcePeriod: 2014-08-28 ITS; statistical comparability for 2009/2011; original illustration survey date unknown
properties.method: Original municipal raster source-region digitization at the INSIDE EDGE of the actual teal boundary band. Four-neighbor non-stroke cells are traced; only the fully enclosed numeric label disk is restored. Exact cell-run set union; no gap bridging, point buffers, clipping, current-road replacement, or geometric repair. Frozen affine municipal-perimeter registration to EOV and inverse projection to WGS84.
reviewNotes: This is a cartographic inside-stroke interpretation, not a cadastral/surveyed/current legal boundary.
The source-city outline differs from today on the east; whole-perimeter fit residuals are not independent interior accuracy.
Map-stroke width and unknown source projection/georeferencing create unknown positional uncertainty.
Numerical label disks are cartographic annotation; removing their artificial interior hole does not fill any other source hole.
properties.license: Municipal map reuse rights not independently established; ODbL applies to OSM calibration and name evidence.
